descriptionChirho: To place or put something around or upon a person or object. Used concretely of placing a sponge on a reed and holding it to Jesus' mouth (Matt 27:48; Mark 15:36), putting a purple robe on Jesus (Matt 27:28; Mark 15:17), placing a crown of thorns around Jesus' head (John 19:2), setting a hedge around a vineyard (Matt 21:33; Mark 12:1), and bestowing greater honor on the less presentable members of the body (1 Cor 12:23). All multilingual glosses converge on placing/putting around: Arabic wada'a/ahata/albasuhu, German umgeben/auflegen, French mettre autour/appliquer, Hebrew sam/heshiv, Hindi rakhna/lagana, Korean dureu-da/ssiu-da, Spanish poner alrededor/vestir.
